evidence.quote: Generate an API token for Jira using your Atlassian Account
Forge apps and Connect apps use more secure methods for authentication: OAuth 2.0 and JWT respectively.
OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps are created and managed in the developer console.
Users trying to install an unapproved OAuth 2.0 integration are warned that the app has not yet been reviewed by Atlassian.

Official remote MCP server for Atlassian. Securely connect Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, and Compass to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI tools using OAuth 2.1 or API tokens.
The Jira Cloud platform REST API enables you to interact with Jira Cloud programmatically.

result.notes: Anyone can sign up for a free Atlassian/Jira account and generate an API token immediately at id.atlassian.com/manage/api-tokens, or register an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app for free in the developer console (personal-use apps need no approval; public distribution requires Atlassian Marketplace review). REST API covers 487+ endpoints. Atlassian also publishes an official hosted MCP server (mcp.atlassian.com) supporting OAuth 2.1 and API tokens, GA Feb 2026.
result.one_liner: Jira is Atlassian's issue-tracking and project-management platform with a large, well-documented Cloud REST API.
